title: Assam CM encouraging protests against Judges in Zubeen Garg death case: Akhil Gogoi

ai.summary: Akhil Gogoi, leader of the Zubeen Garg Nyay Dabi Samiti, accused Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma of encouraging protests against judges and witnesses in the Zubeen Garg death case, claiming the CM's remarks targeted the Assam government's handling of the investigation.

facts.claim: Akhil Gogoi, Sibsagar MLA and Raijor Dal president, accused Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma of encouraging people to protest against Judges and witnesses in the Zubeen Garg death case
facts.quote: Sibsagar MLA and Raijor Dal president Akhil Gogoi has accused Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma of encouraging people to protest against Judges and witnesses in the Zubeen Garg death case.

facts.claim: The Chief Minister flagged a threat to his family after a group threatened to besiege his house over the case
facts.quote: On Friday (November 6, 2026), the Chief Minister flagged a threat to his family after a group threatened to besiege his house over the case.

facts.claim: Mr Gogoi said the Chief Minister’s remarks amounted to contempt of court
facts.quote: Mr Gogoi, who leads the Samiti, responded by saying the Chief Minister’s remarks amounted to contempt of court.

facts.claim: Denying he threatened the judiciary, the MLA said his protests targeted the Assam government’s handling of the investigation
facts.quote: Denying he threatened the judiciary, the MLA said his protests targeted the Assam government’s handling of the investigation.

facts.claim: We are protesting against the executive’s failure to submit a charge sheet supported by adequate evidence before the court
facts.quote: We are protesting against the executive’s failure to submit a charge sheet supported by adequate evidence before the court,

facts.claim: The Chief Minister also advised people to confront some 160 witnesses who allegedly did a volte-face to let singer Amritprava Mahanta, one of the seven accused in the Garg death case, get bail on October 9
facts.quote: the Chief Minister also advised people to confront some 160 witnesses who allegedly did a volte-face to let singer Amritprava Mahanta, one of the seven accused in the Garg death case, get bail on October 9.

facts.claim: Garg died while swimming in the sea off the island country on September 19, 2025
facts.quote: Garg died while swimming in the sea off the island country on September 19, 2025.

facts.claim: The SIT failed to establish important circumstantial evidence and that deficiencies in its charge sheet weakened the prosecution’s case
facts.quote: He said the SIT failed to establish important circumstantial evidence and that deficiencies in its charge sheet weakened the prosecution’s case.

facts.claim: The Chief Minister described Garg’s death as a planned murder in November 2025
facts.quote: He also recalled the Chief Minister’s statement in the Assembly in November 2025, in which he described Garg’s death as a planned murder.

ai.background_note: Akhil Gogoi leads the Zubeen Garg Nyay Dabi Samiti, which is protesting against the Assam government's handling of the Zubeen Garg death case, accusing the Chief Minister of encouraging protests against judges and witnesses.
